import sys
import math

def mini(a, b):
    return min(a, b)

def maxi(a, b):
    return max(a, b)

def _dbg(s, *args):
    pass  # Debug function placeholder

def add_mod(a, b, P):
    a += b
    if a >= P:
        a -= P
    return a

def update_self(a, b, P):
    return (a * b) % P

def multiply(a, b, P):
    return (a * b) % P

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    n, m, P = map(int, data[:3])
    # Initialize arrays
    MAX = 511
    dwu = [[0] * (MAX) for _ in range(MAX)]
    dp1 = [0] * MAX
    dp2 = [[0] * MAX for _ in range(MAX)]
    dp3 = [[0] * MAX for _ in range(MAX)]
    cnt = [0] * MAX

    # Precompute binomial coefficients
    for i in range(n + 1):
        for j in range(i + 1):
            if j == 0:
                dwu[i][j] = 1
            else:
                dwu[i][j] = add_mod(dwu[i - 1][j], dwu[i - 1][j - 1], P)

    # Compute dp1 and cnt
    dp1[0] = 0
    cnt[0] = 1
    for i in range(1, m + 1):
        for j in range(i):
            val = 0
            val = add_mod(val, multiply(dp1[j], cnt[i - j - 1], P), P)
            val = add_mod(val, multiply(dp1[i - j - 1], cnt[j], P), P)
            val = update_self(val, j + 1, P)
            temp = multiply(cnt[i - j - 1], cnt[j], P)
            temp = update_self(temp, j * (j + 1) // 2, P)
            val = update_self(val, temp, P)
            val = update_self(val, dwu[i - 1][j], P)
            dp1[i] = add_mod(dp1[i], val, P)
            temp2 = dwu[i - 1][j]
            temp2 = update_self(temp2, cnt[j], P)
            temp2 = update_self(temp2, cnt[i - j - 1], P)
            temp2 = update_self(temp2, j + 1, P)
            cnt[i] = add_mod(cnt[i], temp2, P)
        cnt[i] = add_mod(cnt[i], cnt[i], P)
        dp1[i] = add_mod(dp1[i], dp1[i], P)

    # Compute dp2 and dp3
    dp2[0][0] = 1
    dp3[0][0] = 0
    for i in range(n + 1):
        for j in range(m + 1):
            for k in range(m + 1):
                if j + k <= m and i + k + 1 <= n + 1:
                    val = dp2[i][j]
                    val = update_self(val, dwu[m - j][k], P)
                    val = update_self(val, cnt[k], P)
                    val3 = dp3[i][j]
                    val3 = update_self(val3, cnt[k], P)
                    val3 = add_mod(val3, multiply(dp1[k], dp2[i][j], P), P)
                    val3 = update_self(val3, dwu[m - j][k], P)
                    dp3[i + k + 1][j + k] = add_mod(dp3[i + k + 1][j + k], val3, P)
                    dp2[i + k + 1][j + k] = add_mod(dp2[i + k + 1][j + k], val, P)

    print(dp3[n + 1][m])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
